tables.name: posts
tables.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE posts
(
    Id                    INTEGER          not null UNIQUE
        primary key,
    PostTypeId            INTEGER          null,
    AcceptedAnswerId      INTEGER          null,
    CreaionDate           DATETIME     null,
    Score                 INTEGER          null,
    ViewCount             INTEGER          null,
    Body                  TEXT     null,
    OwnerUserId           INTEGER          null,
    LasActivityDate       DATETIME     null,
    Title                 TEXT null,
    Tags                  TEXT null,
    AnswerCount           INTEGER          null,
    CommentCount          INTEGER          null,
    FavoriteCount         INTEGER          null,
    LastEditorUserId      INTEGER          null,
    LastEditDate          DATETIME     null,
    CommunityOwnedDate    DATETIME    null,
    ParentId              INTEGER          null,
    ClosedDate            DATETIME     null,
    OwnerDisplayName      TEXT null,
    LastEditorDisplayName TEXT null,
        foreign key (LastEditorUserId) references users (Id)
            on update cascade on delete cascade,
        foreign key (OwnerUserId) references users (Id)
            on update cascade on delete cascade,
        foreign key (ParentId) references posts (Id)
            on update cascade on delete cascade
)

steps.thought: Load all post IDs with ViewCount between 100 and 150 from the SQLite DB, then scan comments.csv to find the comment (Text) with the highest Score among those PostIds.

action_input.code:
import sqlite3, csv
# Get post IDs with ViewCount between 100 and 150
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/posts.db')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150')
post_ids = {str(row[0]) for row in cur.fetchall()}
conn.close()

# Scan comments.csv for comments whose PostId is in post_ids and find max score
max_score = None
max_comment = None
max_row = None
with open('csv/comments.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        if r['PostId'] in post_ids:
            try:
                s = int(r['Score'])
            except:
                continue
            if (max_score is None) or (s > max_score):
                max_score = s
                max_comment = r['Text']
                max_row = r

print(max_score)
# print identifying info and truncated comment for verification
print(max_row if max_row is not None else None)
# For safety, also print length of comment
print(len(max_comment) if max_comment else 0)
